content.text:
I'm trying to figure out the rule for which portion of the path gets kept across the examples, checking whether it's tied to the trailing color band or some other segment pattern.

Then it clicks: in each example the band being removed is specifically color 3, so the rule must just be erasing everything colored 3 and leaving the rest untouched. I want to verify this against another example before committing.
